capabilities: Zoom and pan rendered mermaid diagrams
Export diagrams as PNG or SVG
Edit mermaid code in a split-view editor with live preview
Copy or delete mermaid code blocks from the canvas
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: turns every mermaid code block into an interactive canvas
problem: Obsidian renders mermaid diagrams as static, cramped SVGs that are hard to read, inspect, or export.
summary: Mermaid diagram enhancer that renders every mermaid code block as an interactive canvas with zoom, pan, fullscreen, export, and a split code editor.
